records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Wanted to check whether the onboarding made sense or whether anything got in the way. No action needed if everything's going smoothly.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Partners
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and three unanswered Wrenfield emails (789c9c16, 2b9e1cae, 9471751c) show no engagement signal. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance, but silence after onboarding makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

I don't want to keep filling your inbox, so this is my last check-in unless you'd like more.

If it's useful: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about how your team would use it.

Best,
Nadia
